course_geometry.description: Photo-inspired provisional course; positions, heights and tunnel width are adjustable, not measured from the photo.
assumptions: Open corridor, no roof as pictured
Ramp completion is separate from corridor navigation

controller: physics-driven programmed gait with ideal pose feedback
pass_scope: ramp only; corridor navigation not assessed
limitations: Approximate contact proxies and box inertias
Rigid 300 mm ramp; flexible real panel is not modelled
Peak servo model, no thermal limits or voltage sag
Heading and optional lateral feedback use ideal simulated pose
No proof of full CAD clearance at combined joint poses
